description: Template sheets people share: whole sheets built for something (a budget, a shop's orders), with their tabs, formulas, Glance cards and questions. install_template builds one in the person's Google Drive; each also has a copyUrl for copying it in Google Sheets, except one marked originalGone, whose author deleted its sheet: install_template still builds it from TrackerHacker's backup. Search with what the person tracks and the services or senders its rows come from: names, descriptions and the hacks for each template's topic are searched, so "shopify" or "chase" finds the template those fill. Templates by TrackerHacker LLC are the official ones.

category.description: Only templates in this template library category.

query.description: Words like "card spending", or a bank, shop or service: "chase", "shopify".
